name: music-maker-plugin
description: Full-stack AI music producer plugin for composing, arranging, and rendering instrumental music and beats with SoundFonts (.sf2), covering advanced harmony (Neo-Riemannian PLR/Tonnetz, Negative Harmony, Lendvai Axis, LCC, Film CMCR, Upper Structure Triads, Gospel Polychords, Barry Harris, Coltrane cycles), counterpoint/fugue/12-tone/pc-set/spectral/Schillinger craft, symphonic & Big-Band orchestration (Piston, Rimsky-Korsakov, ACTOR grouping, Drop/Spread/Cascade voicings), drum/groove architecture, guitar/bass expression, MPE, sustain pedal & strumming, and aligned multi-track WAV stems.
suggestedPrompts: Activate music_maker_plugin and compose an original instrumental beat with expressive dynamics, pedal sustain, and full multi_track stems.
Design a symphonic or Big-Band arrangement with Upper Structure voicings, Neo-Riemannian/Negative Harmony reharmonization, ACTOR timbre blending, and verified WAV/MIDI output.
